speaker: Sheldon
text: Apparently I was wrong. Congratulations.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Old comic book. I just retrieved it from my safe deposit box.

speaker: Penny
text: Oh, hey, Sheldon. What you got there? A new comic book? What do you have a safe deposit box for?

speaker: Sheldon
text: Old comic books. I lost this to Wolowitz in an ill-considered cricket wager.

speaker: Penny
text: What, do they have Wii cricket now? That can't be very popular.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Penny, I'd rather not talk about it.

speaker: Penny
text: Well, if it makes you feel any better, I'm not feeling so hot either.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Why would that make me feel better?

speaker: Penny
text: I don't know. Empathy? Anyway, I'm just saying that you're feeling upset about something with Howard and I'm upset about something with Leonard.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Yes, yes, the disappointing sex. That's an inexact parallel. You and Leonard can always return to being friends, whereas I can never return to a state in which Wolowitz has not bested me like Mrs. Riley's chicken.

speaker: Penny
text: What's Mrs. Riley's chicken?

speaker: Sheldon
text: The chicken that was owned by Mrs. Riley.

speaker: Penny
text: Wait, forget the chicken.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Oh, I wish I could.

speaker: Penny
text: I don't know, you may be right about me and Leonard.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Of course I'm right. What are the odds I'd be wrong twice in one week?

speaker: Penny
text: No, I mean, we can always go back to being friends.

speaker: Sheldon
text: I just said that. This conversation has started to circle, meeting adjourned. Hello.

speaker: Leonard
text: Enjoy Oxnard. I'm sure your daughter's looking forward to having you. What's going on?

speaker: Sheldon
text: Oh, you'd like to catch up on the events of the day, all right? Well, there was a half hour wait at the bank to get into my safe deposit box, I was forced to talk to Penny about your sexual problems, and oh yes, in a moment filled with biblical resonance, pride wenteth before my fall, causing my flash 123 to goeth to Wolowitz.

speaker: Leonard
text: Wait a minute, you talked to Penny about our sex life?

speaker: Sheldon
text: Leonard, it astonishes me how you continually fixate on the trivial. I lost a bet to Wolowitz.

speaker: Leonard
text: Right, right, you're saying you talked to Penny? Interesting. Excuse me.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Yes. Hardly.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Have I crossed some sort of line again?

speaker: Leonard
text: A little bit.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Hmm.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Oh, who cares?

speaker: Penny
text: Oh, hey.

speaker: Leonard
text: Hey, what did Sheldon say to you?

speaker: Penny
text: Not a lot. Just that we always have the option of going back to being friends.

speaker: Leonard
text: Is that what you want?

speaker: Penny
text: I don't know. I mean, I have to admit, things seemed simpler when we were just friends.

speaker: Leonard
text: I guess.

speaker: Penny
text: Would take the pressure off?

speaker: Leonard
text: It would, wouldn't it?

speaker: Penny
text: So, we'll just be friends.
